excludedList.documentTitle: Excluded Occupation List for the SINP's Express Entry Category and the Occupations In-Demand Category
excludedList.note: NOCs excluded from the points-based Occupations In-Demand (OID) and Express Entry (EE) sub-categories. NOC TEER 4 and TEER 5 are also ineligible for OID/EE. Excluded occupations may still be eligible through employer-driven International Skilled Worker / Saskatchewan Work Experience routes (incl. the sector-capped Employer Position Assessment pathway) where the employer has SINP approval for the job offer.

sectorModel.note: From 2026 the SINP allocation (≈4,761 nominations) is sector-based. Sector membership is determined by the employer's job/sector at Employer Position Assessment (EPA) time, not by an applicant-facing NOC list — so this model is shown as context, not auto-classified per NOC.

prioritySectors.allocationNote: Minimum 50% of total allocation reserved for priority sectors. Priority-sector candidates face no capped intake window.

cappedSectors.allocationNote: 25% of total allocation capped across three sectors. Once a sector's cap is reached, EPAs are accepted only if more nominations are needed to meet targets. To be eligible for an intake period, the employer must have an identified candidate whose work permit expires within the next six months.

sectorModel.epaNote: The Employer Position Assessment (EPA) — formerly the Job Approval Form (JAF) — is the employer-driven route. It is the pathway for capped-sector occupations and for occupations excluded from the points-based OID/EE sub-categories, where the employer has SINP job-offer approval.
